title: MailKit
description: A cross-platform mail client library for IMAP, POP3, and SMTP in .NET.

data.text: `MailKit` is a comprehensive mail client library for .NET. It supports IMAP, POP3, SMTP, and NNTP with full async support, SASL authentication, and modern security features.
Use `SmtpClient` to connect to an SMTP server and send messages. MailKit supports modern authentication methods like OAuth 2.0.

data.title: Send an Email
data.content: Send an email via SMTP with MailKit.

data.text: Use `ImapClient` to connect to an IMAP server, fetch messages, and parse them.

data.title: Fetch Inbox Messages
data.content: Connect to IMAP and list recent subjects.

terms.definition: Sends email messages via SMTP with async support.
Connects to IMAP servers to read and manage email.
Represents an email message following the MIME standard.

data.title: Tip
data.text: MailKit is created by the same author as MimeKit. Use MimeKit to build rich HTML emails with inline images and attachments.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: MailKit supports SMTP, IMAP, and POP3
Full async API with cancellation support
MimeKit builds rich MIME email content
data.takeaway: MailKit is the most complete mail client library available for .NET.
